plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Criminal Justice, Emphasis of Study, Associate in Art - 60 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/26; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed; term totals 15/15/15/15 = 60 reconcile exactly. Genuine catalog typos kept verbatim: 'Associate in Art' (header), 'Arts & Humanitites Requirement'. The map assumes a Fall (August) start; if transferring to a 4-year school, the preferred math course is College Algebra. To meet the Social & Behavioral Sciences criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ANTH, ECON, GEOG, POLS, PSYC, SOCI). To meet the Arts & Humanities criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ARTS, COMM, DANC, ENGL, HIST, LITR, LANG, MUSI, PHIL, RELI, THEA).
